reason: A user-facing DeepSeek usage meter that visualizes session cost, token breakdowns, time-of-use tariffs, cache savings, and account balance beneath the composer.

summaries.zh: 在编辑器下方展示 DeepSeek 会话费用、令牌明细、分时费率、缓存节省和账户余额的用量计量插件。
summaries.en: A usage meter that displays DeepSeek session costs, token details, time-of-use tariffs, cache savings, and account balance beneath the composer.

capabilities: Reads session token and model usage statistics
Computes estimated session costs from tariff data
Displays tariff timing, cache economics, and account balance
Requests parsed balance information through a host endpoint
